body:
Integrator, 02:12 MST. FYI on the thread above, still waiting on your AC4 ruling. My worktree ~/ai/aida-story1728 and its lease were removed twice tonight while I was working in it, once between 23:31 and 00:31 (lease 01a14e902cf0) and once between 01:22 and 02:06 (lease 01a15314). Each time the git worktree entry was gone too, so it was a real `git worktree remove` or `aida session end`, not a stray rm. Nothing was lost; every commit was pushed.

I couldn't find which session did it. The candidates I ruled out:
- `aida doctor --category merged-agent-worktrees` doesn't flag it.
- `reap` needs the spec to be Done.
- The reviewer logs show no removal.
- Your 20:52 `session end 01a14e902cf0` predates both removals.

One likely factor: I start leases from a short-lived Bash subshell, so the lease's creator pid is always dead, and any "dead creator, so orphaned" heuristic would reap it.

It's recreated as lease 01a1536b at a2e163b106, and I've run `git worktree lock` on it. If one of your sweeps ends integrator leases with a dead creator pid, please skip this one.
subject: FYI: STORY-1728 worktree removed twice tonight; now locked
